# AI and LLM Observability

Monitor, optimize, and secure Generative AI applications, LLMs, and agentic workflows -
improving performance, explainability, and compliance.

## Seamless Integration Across the Full AI Application Stack
Supported platforms:
- Amazon Bedrock
- Azure AI Foundry
- LangChain
- NVIDIA NIM
- OpenAI
- Google Vertex AI

## Seven-Layer Observability Framework
1. Business Impact - Track productivity gains, support ticket deflection, autonomous
   operations, and ROI.
2. Application Performance - Trace end-user experience, availability, and reliability of
   AI-powered applications.
3. Orchestration Layer - Monitor chain performance, guardrails, and prompt caching across
   frameworks.
4. Agent-to-Agent Communication - Observe protocols, command execution, tool usage, and
   multi-agent communications.
5. Model Integrity - Assess token usage, cost, stability, latency, errors, and resource
   utilization.
6. Semantic Caches and Vector Databases - Monitor RAG pipelines, data volume, distribution,
   and retrieval patterns.
7. Infrastructure Monitoring - Track GPU, TPU, and compute resource utilization, saturation,
   and errors.

## Key Capabilities

Cost Reduction & Performance:
- Monitor operational metrics via unified, customizable dashboards
- Intelligent detection identifies behavioral changes and predicts cost increases
- Reduce AI agent/LLM response times through trace analysis
- A/B testing insights for model comparison
- Monitor token costs and AI coding agent reliability

Trust & Guardrails:
- Monitor guardrail metrics to mitigate biases and misuse
- Detect model hallucinations and prompt injection attempts
- Prevent PII leakage and detect toxic language
- Analyze guardrail effectiveness

Explainability & Tracing:
- End-to-end visibility into request execution across frontend, backend, orchestrations,
  RAG, LLM, and agentic layers
- Log, trace, and map service dependencies
- Automatic root cause detection for errors in LLM chains

AI Evaluations/LLM-as-a-Judge:
- Continuously measure accuracy, relevance, and grounding of outputs
- Detect model drift and safety issues
- Compare evaluation scores across versions
- Set alerts for quality drift
- Monitor hallucinations and ungrounded responses

Compliance & Security:
- Document all inputs/outputs with full data lineage
- Store prompts for up to 10 years
- Build transparency dashboards for regulatory compliance
- Monitor infrastructure data for carbon reduction initiatives
